def: An extensible benchmark environment (Debenedetti et al., 2024) of realistic tool-using tasks, such as email, banking and travel, paired with prompt-injection attacks to measure agent utility and security together.
practice: Released with 97 tasks and 629 security test cases; because it reports task success next to attack success, a defense that blocks attacks by breaking the task shows up, and defenses such as CaMeL report results on it.
